competitors.name: TÜV SÜD
competitors.observation: Shows that product testing, documentation and production monitoring are distinct parts of a controlled program; no ChinaFreeWeight certification claim is made.

competitors.name: REP Fitness
competitors.observation: Model instructions show why orientation and model-specific warranty language matter; adjustable-model statements were not generalized.

competitors.name: Eleiko
competitors.observation: Publishes model-specific validation evidence; its figures were excluded from the article because they cannot be transferred to another design.

rejectedTopics: Export packaging for dumbbells and plates — an exact live owner already exists.
OEM free-weight sample approval — an exact multilingual owner already exists.
Artwork and logo approval — the custom-logo guide owns the intent.
Weight-plate runout and concentricity — current flatness and plate-to-bar fit pages create a higher collision risk.
siteGaps: No existing page owns the specimen family → landing setup → before-and-after evidence → stop and quarantine → production change-control workflow for fixed dumbbells.

sources.title: TÜV SÜD certification mark for dumbbells
sources.use: Official summary of documentation, construction review, testing, production monitoring and factory surveillance; no certification is claimed for ChinaFreeWeight.

sources.title: TÜV SÜD German certification page for fixed dumbbells
sources.use: Official program language showing foreseeable misuse may be simulated with drop testing; no universal method or threshold is inferred.

sources.title: ISO 20957-1:2024 stationary training equipment
sources.use: Scope boundary reviewed; applicability to a loose fixed dumbbell is not assumed.

sources.title: REP x PÉPIN FAST Series adjustable dumbbell
sources.use: Model-specific instructions illustrate why landing orientation and abuse exclusions matter; adjustable-model claims are not generalized.

sources.title: IRON COMPANY fixed urethane dumbbells
sources.use: Model-specific handling and warranty language reviewed; not generalized to all fixed dumbbells.

sources.title: Eleiko Evo fixed dumbbell
sources.use: Manufacturer example of model-specific validation; published figures were not copied or transferred.

sources.title: Reddit buyer discussion of a damaged dumbbell
sources.use: Buyer wording only; anecdotal content is not treated as engineering evidence.

limitations: Quora pages were not used because automated verification was blocked; no claim depends on them.
Reddit was used only to understand buyer wording, never as product or engineering proof.
The paid keyword refresh is reserved for Sunday under the shared policy; this Friday run used public search, live sitemaps, repository content and the shared topic ledger.
No universal drop height, repetition count or acceptance threshold is stated because the product design, use case, market and contract must define them.
Commissioned images are conceptual editorial illustrations, not evidence of an actual customer project or factory validation.
